battle.name: 亞述征服埃蘭
battle.theater: 底格里斯河下游胡爾特希河兩岸
battle.brief: 公元前655年，亞述王亞述巴尼拔率軍自底格里斯河中游南下，越過胡爾特希河，在埃蘭王特烏曼集結的軍隊面前擊潰其鋒，國王北逃後身亡。卡面這件亞述長矛是亞述步兵的骨幹：短柄鐵刃，與弓盾同列，護住後排弓手，在正面硬撼埃蘭的車兵與騎兵。此役只是八年征伐的開端，終局是蘇薩陷落、埃蘭滅國。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 這場戰爭是公元前七世紀中葉亞述帝國對西南方的埃蘭王國的戰役，交戰地帶在底格里斯河與胡爾特希河（喀爾克赫河）之間的蘇西安納平原，終點是埃蘭都城蘇薩。亞述一方是亞述巴尼拔統治下的新亞述帝國：王權高度集中，國王自任全軍主帥，軍隊由步兵方陣、輕騎、兩輪輕車、攻城工兵與工匠兵（sappers）組成，另有分遣的省級總督與軍團首領率領的支線部隊；命令靠騎使與號角傳遞，隊形一旦拉開就很難重新協同。這套編制建立在亞述各城邦的舊有軍事傳統之上，又疊加了一套成熟的御前會議與書吏系統，國王同時是這場戰爭的行政總指揮。埃蘭一方是伊朗高原西緣的古老王國，國王特烏曼直接統率由蘇薩、蘇西安納及周邊高地邦國抽來的步兵與弓手，配以本地良種馬的騎兵與雙輪馬車，另有為數甚多的役屬人口（埃蘭語 ippu）編成的勞動與搬運隊；埃蘭的軍隊在開闊的沖積平原上以騎兵衝鋒見長，卻缺乏亞述那樣規模化的攻城工程能力。埃蘭並非孤軍：在前655年之前，埃蘭已與埃及第二十六王朝的國王普薩姆提克一世以及巴比倫王沙瑪什-舒姆-烏金結盟，得到外國的兵員與器械支援。地理上的關鍵在於蘇薩的位置：城在胡爾特希河東岸的低窪處，四面是鹽沼與春季氾濘的沖積地，進攻方必須先渡過這條河並鋪築棧道，而城外的開闊地又是埃蘭騎兵最能發揮威力的場所。
countriesEn: This war was a campaign of the Assyrian empire against the Elamite kingdom to its south-west in the middle of the seventh century BC. The ground of the fighting lay in the plain of Susiana between the Tigris and the Ulai, the Karkheh river, and the destination was Susa, the capital of Elam. On the Assyrian side stood the Neo-Assyrian empire under Ashurbanipal. Kingship was highly concentrated, the king served as commander in chief of the entire host, and the army was composed of infantry blocks, light cavalry, light two-wheeled chariots, siege engineers and sappers, with detached columns led by provincial governors and commanders of the regular troops. Orders travelled by mounted messenger and by horn, and once a formation drew apart it was very difficult to bring back into coordination. This structure rested on the older military traditions of the Assyrian cities and was overlaid with a mature system of royal councils and scribes, so that the king was at once the administrative director of the war. On the Elamite side stood an ancient kingdom on the western edge of the Iranian plateau. The king Teumman personally commanded infantry and archers drawn from Susa, from Susiana and from the highland tribes around them, supported by cavalry and two-wheeled chariots on locally bred horses, together with large numbers of dependent labourers, the ippu of Elamite usage, organised into work and transport companies. The Elamite host was at its best in cavalry charge across open alluvial country, but it lacked the systematic siege engineering of Assyria. Elam did not fight alone: before 655 BC it had already allied itself with Psamtik I, the king of the twenty-sixth dynasty of Egypt, and with the Babylonian king Shamash-shum-ukin, and drew foreign troops and materiel from those partners. The decisive geographical point is the position of Susa: the city lay in low ground on the east bank of the Ulai, ringed by salt flats and by alluvial ground that turned to mud in the spring, so that an attacking army had first to cross the river and build a causeway across it, while the open ground outside the walls was precisely the terrain in which Elamite cavalry was strongest.
people: 留下姓名的關鍵人物分屬兩條脈絡。亞述方面的主宰是國王亞述巴尼拔（前668至前631年在位），他在尼尼微的北宮把自己的形象經營成一位既通曉書寫又能治國的君主，這場戰爭的每一次勝利都被寫成王室年表中的一條；他的兄弟沙瑪什-舒姆-烏金是巴比倫之王，前663年前後起兵反叛亞述，兵敗後逃入埃蘭，在埃蘭的庇護下自焚而死，這條個人命運把巴比倫、埃蘭與亞述三方的衝突綁成一條線。埃蘭方面的核心是國王特烏曼：他在前667年之後利用亞述王位交替的混亂脫離亞述的宗主地位，以娶亞述公主作為保障，又與埃及簽訂攻守同盟；前655年，他集結包括車兵與騎兵在內的大軍，公開在胡爾特希河東岸應戰，兵敗北走，數月後被自己人所殺，頭顱被送到尼尼微。他的兩個兒子塔瑪魯-塔什與塔瑪魯恩塔什先後爭奪王位：前653年塔瑪魯-塔什奪蘇薩為王，前652年在埃蘭的西帕爾兵敗被擒，前648年又起兵，終於在前647年覆亡。遠方還有埃及法老普薩姆提克一世，他與埃蘭的結盟被亞述看作最嚴重的威脅，也是後來巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒得以在亞述的西線牽制住強敵的原因。亞述軍中還有一類不留姓名的角色：統率的王子與近衛、負責渡河與築台的工匠兵、抄錄年表的書吏；而最關鍵的第一手材料「塔瑪爾書信」，正是一名投奔埃蘭的亞述人塔瑪爾寫給埃蘭王的書信，他在信中描述亞述饑荒的慘狀，構成本卡理解前655年之後戰局的直接依據。
peopleEn: The named figures of consequence fall into two lines. The master of the Assyrian side is the king Ashurbanipal, who reigned from 668 to 631 BC. In the northern palace of Nineveh he cultivated an image of himself as a ruler both skilled in writing and competent in government, and every victory in this war was entered as a line of the royal annals. His brother Shamash-shum-ukin was king of Babylon; he rose against Assyria around 663 BC, was defeated, fled to Elam, and there burned himself to death, and that personal trajectory bound together the conflict of Babylon, Elam and Assyria in a single thread. The pivot on the Elamite side was the king Teumman. After 667 BC he used the confusion that followed a change of Assyrian kingship to break loose from Assyrian suzerainty, took an Assyrian princess in marriage as his guarantee, and concluded an offensive-defensive alliance with Egypt. In 655 BC he mustered a large army of infantry, chariots and cavalry and openly offered battle on the east bank of the Ulai; he was routed, fled north, and after a few months was killed by his own men, his head being carried to Nineveh. His two sons, Tammaritu and Tammaruntash, fought over the succession: in 653 BC Tammaritu seized Susa and made himself king, in 652 BC he was defeated at Sippar of Elam and taken prisoner, and in 648 BC he rose again, only to be crushed in 647 BC. In the distance stood the Egyptian pharaoh Psamtik I, whose alliance with Elam the Assyrians regarded as the gravest threat and who later enabled the Babylonian king Nebuchadnezzar to pin the great power down on its western flank. Among the Assyrians there is also a class of figures who leave no names: the princes and guards who served as commanders, the sappers responsible for fords and causeways, the scribes who copied the annals. And the single most important first-hand text, the so-called Tamar letters, consists of letters written by an Assyrian named Tamar who had fled to Elam to the Elamite king; in them he describes the state of famine in Assyria, and they are the direct basis for understanding the situation after 655 BC.
kits: 卡面上這件亞述長矛，是亞述步兵裝備的核心：短柄、長刃，矛頭為鐵，柄為木，握持位置靠近重心，因此既能刺穿也能投擲，士兵列陣時以肩相抵，把矛尖連成一道鐵的界線。亞述人在公元前十世紀前後把鐵與弓綁在一處，形成一套混合的步兵裝備：長矛與大盾在前，弓手在後，鐵鏃箭矢用來壓制敵陣的展開，等到敵人接近矛尖可及的距离才讓開陣線、讓出通道，再以鐵刃短刀與斧完成貼身格鬥；鎧甲多為鐵片或銅片串成的鱗甲，頭部有盔；輕騎以馬刀與投槍為主，兩輪輕車配雙馬，主要供國王與近衛使用。攻城方面有土坡、木製圍牆、棧道、突擊用的撞槌與攻城塔，前面還配備工匠兵（sappers）挖塹壕、決水與架橋；蘇薩四面是胡爾特希河的支汊與沼澤，攻方必須築橋渡水、鋪路運機，工程量遠勝於野戰。埃蘭的裝備則是伊朗高原的樣子：長矛、複合弓與圓盾，數量可觀的雙輪馬車與騎兵，本地出產的高身馬匹足以支撐大規模的平原機動；埃蘭也用撞槌，但不是攻城用的撞槌，而是把特烏曼的頭顱鑲在槌頭作為羞辱與戰術道具，這件在蘇薩被亞述繳獲的器物，成為復仇敘事裡最具畫面感的細節。運輸與補給方面，亞述靠牛車、騾、驢與人力，關鍵路段用水路船運；埃蘭境內的鹽沼與氾濘地對車兵極不友善，亞述在遲滯的季節裡不得不把部分戰車與糧車棄在後方。
kitsEn: The Assyrian spear on the card is the core of Assyrian infantry equipment: a short shaft, a long blade, an iron head and a wooden haft, gripped close to the centre of mass so that it can be used both to thrust and to throw, and when soldiers stood shoulder to shoulder in line their spear tips joined into a continuous edge of iron. Around the tenth century BC the Assyrians bound iron and the bow together into a combined infantry outfit: spears and large shields in front, archers behind, iron-tipped arrows used to deny the enemy the chance to deploy, and the line opened only when the enemy came within reach of the spear point, after which short iron knives and axes finished the work at close quarters. Armour was usually scale armour of iron or bronze links, with helmets above it. Light cavalry carried the sword and the lance, and the light two-wheeled chariot drawn by two horses was the mount of the king and his guard. For siege work there were earthen ramps, timber revetments, causeways, battering rams and siege towers, and sappers worked in front to dig ditches, breach watercourses and build fords. Susa is ringed by branches and marshes of the Ulai, so the attacker had to bridge the river and pave a road to bring his machines across, and the engineering load was far heavier than the open-field fighting. The Elamite equipment is that of the Iranian plateau: spears, composite bows and round shields, a considerable number of two-wheeled chariots and of cavalry, and locally bred tall horses good enough to sustain large-scale manoeuvre across a plain. Elam used a battering ram as well, but not as a siege engine; the head of Teumman was set into the head of the ram as an instrument of humiliation and as a war trophy, and this object, recovered by the Assyrians at Susa, became the most vivid detail in the revenge narrative. Transport and supply rested on ox carts, mules, donkeys and human porters, with river shipping on the critical stretches; the salt flats and flooded ground of Elamite territory were merciless to wheeled transport, and in the slow season the Assyrians were forced to leave part of their chariots and baggage wagons behind.
tactics: 亞述的野戰套路在對埃蘭的戰役裡看得最清楚。步兵以縱隊前進，前排持長矛與大盾構成密集方陣，弓手在方陣之後或兩翼依托盾牆成排射擊，箭矢的作用不是殲滅而是限制敵人展開，迫使對方在不利地形上接受交鋒；騎兵與車隊留在陣後待機，一旦敵陣被箭雨壓出缺口，國王與近衛便以車騎一次投入，不給對方重新整隊的時間。埃蘭的應對是利用開闊的沖積平原：其騎兵在正面以高头大馬發動衝鋒，亞述因此避免與其在硬地上正面競速，而以步兵方陣正面吸住衝鋒、以兩翼迂迴消耗其銳氣，戰術重點落在「不被衝散」與「讓衝鋒隊形耗盡」之間的節奏。渡河與攻城是另一套章法：前655年亞述自底格里斯河中游南下，跨過胡爾特希河，在埃蘭邊境集結；圍攻蘇薩時，亞述先在河上架橋築路，把撞槌與攻城塔運過對岸，再以土坡貼近城牆；埃蘭則以雙重壕溝、臨水溝渠與決水灌入攻軍塹壕來拖延。攻方也用過反制手段：切斷城內供水、築渠把河水引到攻軍一側，把攻城變成堤防與水利的較量。補給線是這場戰爭最脆弱的一環：亞述遠在數百公里之外，糧食靠沿底格里斯河與胡爾特希河的船運與就地徵發，一旦雨季令道路泥濘，遠征就會停滯；埃蘭則可利用蘇薩周邊的鹽沼與渠道，把進攻拖成持久戰。
tacticsEn: The Assyrian pattern of open-field war is clearest of all in the campaigns against Elam. The infantry advanced in column, the front rank carrying spears and large shields to form a dense block, while archers fired in ranks from behind the block or from the flanks behind the shelter of the shields; the function of the arrows was not to destroy but to deny the enemy the chance to deploy, forcing him to accept contact on ground of the Assyrians' choosing. The cavalry and the chariots were held in reserve behind the line, and the moment the arrow shower opened a gap in the enemy line, the king and his guard went in with horse and chariot in a single stroke, giving the enemy no time to reform. The Elamite answer was to exploit the open alluvial plain: their cavalry charged head-on on tall horses, so the Assyrians avoided matching them in speed across hard ground and instead absorbed the charge with the infantry block face to face while the flanks lapped around to spend the momentum of the charge. The tactical question was one of tempo, of not being broken and of letting the charging formation exhaust itself. River crossing and siege were a different chapter. In 655 BC Assyria came down from the middle Tigris, crossed the Ulai and closed up on the Elamite frontier; in the siege of Susa the Assyrians first bridged and paved the river to get the rams and towers across, then brought earthen ramps up against the wall, while Elam held out with double ditches, water channels alongside them, and the practice of cutting water into the attackers' trenches. The attackers had their own counter-measures: cutting off the city's water supply and digging canals to bring river water round to the side of the besiegers, which turned the siege into a contest of dikes and waterworks. Supply was the most fragile link in the whole war. The Assyrian army was hundreds of kilometres from home, and grain came by boat along the Tigris and the Ulai and by requisition on the spot; once the rains turned the roads to mud, the expedition stalled. Elam, for its part, could use the salt flats and the channels around Susa to drag the assault out into a war of attrition.
data: 可以核對的數字大致分三類。其一是年表：中文的戰爭列表把此役繫於公元前655年，學界亦普遍把亞述巴尼拔在位初期對埃蘭的決定性戰役定在前655年；他的在位年為前668至前631年，其後八年間（至前647年）亞述對埃蘭還有數次戰役，前653與前652年各有一役，前647年攻克蘇薩。巴比倫的《拿波連尼撒年表》殘篇在亞述巴尼拔名下連續記載對埃蘭的勝利與蘇薩的劫掠，但這部編年史是巴比倫觀點下的節略本，年份以巴比倫王的在位年推算，並非當時人使用的紀年。其二是距離與地理：亞述首都尼尼微（今摩蘇爾）至蘇薩的直線距離約九百五十至一千公里；胡爾特希河即今之喀爾克赫河，全長約九百五十公里，下游約三百公里可通航，並於北緯三十一點五度、東經四十七點四度附近匯入底格里斯河；蘇薩位於北緯三十二點一九度、東經四十八點二六度。本卡戰場標定取胡爾特希河下游兩岸的開闊地帶（東經四十七點八度、北緯三十一點八度），蘇薩的坐標則在文字中另行標出。其三是規模與物資：亞述王室銘文對兵力的形容一律是「眾多」「無數」，沒有可核的編制數字；已知的硬證據是亞述在埃蘭的攻城中大量使用撞槌與攻城塔，以及前647年蘇薩陷落時亞述銘文記載的繳獲與擄獲，但任何具體的俘虜人數都無從核實。合理的說法是：亞述野戰部隊以數萬量級計，埃蘭聯軍的規模與之相近，一場戰役即決定一國的命運，在這個層級上史料的沉默是可以理解的。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked fall roughly into three classes. The first is chronology. The Chinese list of battles ties this campaign to 655 BC, and scholarship also fixes the decisive Assyrian blow against Elam in the first years of Ashurbanipal's reign at 655 BC. He reigned from 668 to 631 BC, and in the eight years that followed there were further campaigns against Elam, one each in 653 and 652 BC, and the taking of Susa in 647 BC. The Babylonian Chronicle fragment known as the Babylonian King List A preserves, under the entry for Ashurbanipal, a run of victories over Elam and the plunder of Susa, but that chronicle is an abridgement written from a Babylonian point of view and its years are reckoned from the reigns of Babylonian kings rather than from any calendar the people of the time actually used. The second class is distance and geography. The straight-line distance from the Assyrian capital Nineveh, modern Mosul, to Susa is about nine hundred and fifty to a thousand kilometres. The Ulai, the modern Karkheh, runs about nine hundred and fifty kilometres in total, the lower three hundred of them navigable, and joins the Tigris near 31.5 degrees north and 47.4 degrees east. Susa stands at 32.19 degrees north and 48.26 degrees east. The point fixed for this card lies on the open ground along the lower Ulai, at 47.8 degrees east and 31.8 degrees north, while the coordinates of Susa are given separately in the text. The third class is scale and materiel. Assyrian royal inscriptions describe numbers of troops with formulas such as countless and innumerable, and no verifiable establishment figure survives. The hard evidence lies in the extensive use of battering rams and siege towers in the Assyrian campaigns against Elam, and in the booty and captives recorded in the Assyrian inscriptions for the fall of Susa in 647 BC, though no specific captive count can be verified. The defensible statement is that an Assyrian field army was of the order of tens of thousands, that the size of the Elamite coalition was comparable, and that a single battle decided the fate of a kingdom. At that scale the silence of the sources is understandable.
cause: 戰爭的起因要分遠因與近因。遠因是亞述帝國在薩爾貢王之後形成的擴張結構：亞述需要一條從美索不達米亞通往波斯灣與安都斯的穩定通路，需要蘇西安納的鹽、埃蘭高原的馬匹與石料，還需要堵住埃蘭與埃及、巴比倫結成反亞述聯盟的可能。埃蘭自前七世紀起已處於實質獨立的狀態，是亞述南方唯一沒有被直接併入行省的舊王國，亞述對它的態度因此始終帶著「必須重新收服」的性質。近因則非常具體：亞述巴尼拔即位之初，埃蘭王特烏曼趁亞述王位交替與巴比倫叛亂的混亂脫離宗主地位，以娶亞述公主作保障，又與埃及的普薩姆提克一世簽訂攻守同盟；前655年，他集結包括車兵與騎兵在內的大軍公開叛亂，亞述巴尼拔遂率軍南下平叛。饑荒也推了一把：前650年代亞述遭遇嚴重饑荒，大量亞述人淪為餓殍或逃往埃蘭，埃蘭收容了這些逃亡者，亞述巴尼拔在詔令中把收容叛逃者列為埃蘭的罪狀之一，這一指控的原始材料正是前述「塔瑪爾書信」。於是對亞述而言，這場戰爭同時是一場平叛、一場懲罰性遠征，也是一次消滅敵對聯盟的行動；對埃蘭而言，則是把一場邊疆摩擦擴大為兩國存亡之戰的決斷。
causeEn: The origins of the war divide into a distant cause and an immediate one. The distant cause is the expansionary structure the Assyrian empire formed under Sargon: Assyria needed a secure corridor from Mesopotamia to the Persian Gulf and the Indus, needed the salt of Susiana, the horses and the stone of the Elamite highlands, and needed to foreclose the possibility of Elam joining an anti-Assyrian league with Egypt and Babylon. From the seventh century BC Elam stood in effect as an independent power, the only old kingdom to the south of Assyria that had not been directly absorbed into a province, and Assyrian attitudes towards it therefore always carried the character of a thing that had to be reconquered. The immediate cause is far more concrete. In the first years of Ashurbanipal's reign the Elamite king Teumman exploited the confusion surrounding a change of Assyrian kingship and a Babylonian revolt to break free of Assyrian suzerainty, took an Assyrian princess in marriage as his guarantee, and signed an offensive-defensive alliance with Psamtik I of Egypt. In 655 BC he mustered a large army with chariots and cavalry and openly revolted, and Ashurbanipal marched south to put down the rebellion. Famine also pushed things along: in the 650s BC Assyria suffered a severe famine, large numbers of Assyrians starved or fled to Elam, Elam took in those runaways, and Ashurbanipal listed the harbouring of deserters among the crimes of Elam in his edicts. The original material behind that accusation is precisely the series of Tamar letters cited above. For Assyria, then, the war was at once a campaign against rebellion, a punitive expedition and the destruction of an enemy coalition; for Elam it was the decision to turn a frontier quarrel into a war for the survival of the state.
impact: 這場戰爭最深遠的後果是埃蘭作為國家的消失。前647年亞述攻入蘇薩，焚毀城中的宮殿與神廟，將城中的居民與工匠擄往尼尼微，埃蘭王室成員被安置在亞述的土地上，埃蘭的國號此後只作為亞述的一個行省或總督區存在，直到亞述帝國在前七世紀末崩潰，蘇薩先後落入米底與巴比倫的手中，再進入阿契美尼德波斯與塞琉古的版圖。埃蘭的覆亡對兩河流域文明的記憶是一次重創：蘇薩是東方的宗教中心之一，埃蘭的藝術、書寫與神廟傳統在往後的年代裡多以碎片與掠奪物的形式散落，同時也刺激了亞述巴尼拔留下罕見的自我譴責之辭——他曾自述在蘇薩的廢墟上撒鹽，後又在銘文中為這種過度而表達悔意，這是亞述王權對自身破壞行為作出道德回應的罕見例子。軍事上的紅利同樣具體：消滅埃蘭之後，亞述解除了南方與西南兩面的威脅，得以全力對付巴比倫，於是把兩河中下游統一在同一王權之下，亞述巴尼拔統治的晚期實際上已是亞述世界的頂點，一種亞述版的「世界帝國」秩序由此成形。代價同樣存在：遠征年年重出，道路與河道上的補給吃緊，亞述本部連年歉收，帝國的財政與人力被無休止的南方戰事消耗；而亞述對巴比倫的控制愈緊，兩河下游的反抗也隨之累積，這正是前7世紀末亞述突然崩潰的深層原因之一。
impactEn: The deepest consequence of the war was the disappearance of Elam as a state. In 647 BC the Assyrians entered Susa, burned the palaces and the temples, and carried off the inhabitants and the craftsmen of the city to Nineveh, while the members of the Elamite royal house were settled on Assyrian soil. The name of Elam survived only as an Assyrian province or administrative district, until the Assyrian empire itself collapsed at the end of the seventh century BC, after which Susa passed to the Medes and to Babylon and then into the empires of the Achaemenid Persians and of the Seleucids. The fall of Elam was a wound in the memory of Mesopotamian civilisation: Susa had been one of the great religious centres of the east, and the art, the writing and the temple traditions of Elam survived the following centuries mostly as fragments and as the contents of loot, while at the same time it prompted Ashurbanipal to leave behind one of the rare self-accusations in Assyrian royal writing. He stated that he had poured salt upon the ruins of Susa, and later expressed regret for that excess in an inscription, a rare instance of Assyrian kingship making a moral answer to its own act of destruction. The military dividend was equally concrete. With Elam removed, Assyria was freed of pressure from the south and the south-west and could turn its full weight on Babylon, unifying the middle and lower Tigris under a single crown. The late years of Ashurbanipal's reign were effectively the high point of the Assyrian world, and a kind of Assyrian world empire took shape. The cost was equally real. The expeditions came year after year, the roads and the river routes strained to carry them, Assyria itself went through harvest failures, and the fiscal and human resources of the empire were consumed by endless campaigning in the south. The tighter Assyria's grip on Babylon became, the more the lower Euphrates rebellion accumulated, and that is one of the deep reasons for the sudden collapse of Assyria at the end of the seventh century BC.
result: 若以公元前655年那一戰論勝負，結果是亞述大勝：亞述巴尼拔的部隊在胡爾特希河擊潰埃蘭聯軍，埃蘭王特烏曼被衝散後逃入北方，數月後被自己人所殺，頭顱被帶回尼尼微；被河水捲走的埃蘭王族與貴族則被亞述士兵用網兜撈起，連同繳獲的甲兵一起作為戰利品呈獻。全戰爭的最終結果落在前647年：亞述軍隊在再次渡過胡爾特希河後攻入蘇薩，拆毀城牆、焚燒街巷、劫掠神廟的器物，並把殘存居民大批擄走；埃蘭國王與部眾四散，其後繼者塔瑪魯恩塔什在逃亡與復辟之後被消滅，埃蘭的國號從此只作為亞述的行政單位存在。亞述巴尼拔在銘文中記下了最具衝擊力的一句自白：他把鹽撒在蘇薩的廢墟上，並表示此舉超越了常規的懲罰極限；同一批銘文裡也有對此舉的悔意，說明亞述人自己也知道這座城市承擔的宗教分量。亞述的勝利是徹底的，但並不穩固：前627年米底與巴比倫聯軍攻入蘇薩，焚毀亞述在埃蘭的宮殿與設施，這座被亞述砸碎的城，幾十年後成了打擊亞述的踏板，埃蘭的廢墟在波斯與希臘的年代裡再沒有恢復舊日的地位。
resultEn: If the outcome is judged by the battle of 655 BC, the result was a decisive Assyrian victory. The troops of Ashurbanipal broke the Elamite coalition on the Ulai; Teumman was thrown back in the rout, fled north, and after a few months was killed by his own men, his head being carried back to Nineveh. The members of the Elamite royal house and the Elamite nobles who were swept away by the river were pulled out of the water by the Assyrian soldiers in a net, and were presented together with the captured armour as war booty. The final result of the whole war came in 647 BC: the Assyrian army crossed the Ulai again, entered Susa, broke down its walls, burned its streets, looted the vessels of its temples and carried off most of the surviving population. The Elamite king and his people scattered, and his successor Tammaruntash was extinguished after his flight and his attempted restoration, so that the name of Elam survived only as an administrative division of Assyria. In his inscriptions Ashurbanipal set down the most startling line of all: he poured salt on the ruins of Susa and declared that the act had passed the ordinary limit of punishment. The same corpus contains an expression of regret for it, showing that the Assyrians themselves understood the religious weight of that city. The Assyrian victory was total, but it was not secure. In 627 BC a coalition of Medes and Babylonians entered Susa and burned the Assyrian palaces and installations in Elam: the city that Assyria had broken became the stepping stone from which Assyria itself was struck, and the ruins of Elam never regained their old standing in the Persian and Greek ages.
